definition.eligible: exact prior-screen eligibility: non-abstain; at least one answer/alias NFKC+casefold token-normalized with length >=3 (excluding yes/no/true/false) occurs as a substring in concatenated full gold evidence session text
definition.retained: at least one normalized answer/alias occurs as a whole phrase using official.score.normalize and token boundaries in retrieved text restricted to passages whose session ID is in gold evidence
definition.retrieval: BM25 k=4 and deterministic rerank k=4, budget 12000 characters; gold is not passed to retrieval
definition.caveat: Literal retention proxy only; the eligibility condition selects examples with an answer string present in gold-session text and this does not measure answer accuracy.
